Archival Dispatch: 15 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Leo Is on the Air, Movie Previews, Downbeat, and Police Headquarters

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 4 min
Tags: Leo Is on the Air, MGM Studio Previews, Norma Shearer, Lana Turner, Artie Shaw, Jack Benny, Movie Previews, W.C. Fields, Bob Hope, Downbeat, Gene Norman, Country Hoedown, Police Headquarters, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 76 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 76 recovers and dates 15 historical broadcasts spanning classic 1930s Hollywood studio promotional radio discs, theatrical movie trailers, Armed Forces Radio jazz and hillbilly sessions, and early syndicated police procedurals: 4 glamorous Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer radio previews from Leo Is on the Air (1934–1939, previewing Norma Shearer in The Barretts of Wimpole Street, Lana Turner and Artie Shaw in Dancing Co-Ed, and Jack Benny in Man About Town), 3 classic movie trailer broadcasts on Movie Previews (Paramount's The Big Broadcast of 1937 and 1938 with W.C. Fields & Bob Hope, plus Mickey Rooney and Judy Garland's MGM Holiday Special), Gene Norman's AFRS jazz session on Downbeat (1945), 3 vintage advertisements on Old Radio Commercials (Goodyear LifeGuard, Cream of Wheat, and Löwenbräu), 2 down-home country broadcasts on AFRS Country Hoedown (1953–1954), and 2 depression-era crime dramatizations on Police Headquarters (1932).

1. Leo Is on the Air — 1934–1939 MGM Studio Previews

MGM's promotional radio broadcasts featuring film audio clips and star interviews:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate MGM Feature Previewed
Leo_Air_Barretts_Wimpole.mp3 "Leo Is on the Air: 'The Barretts of Wimpole Street' (Norma Shearer & Fredric March)" 1934-09-20 Romantic Victorian drama previewed with the famous MGM lion roar.
Leo_Air_In_Caliente.mp3 "Leo Is on the Air: 'In Caliente' (Dolores del Río & Pat O'Brien)" 1935-05-24 Lavish musical revue preview with Busby Berkeley dance numbers.
Leo_Air_Man_About_Town.mp3 "Leo Is on the Air: Don Wilson presents 'Man About Town' (Jack Benny)" 1939-06-29 Don Wilson introducing Jack Benny's musical comedy extravaganza.
Leo_Air_Dancing_CoEd.mp3 "Leo Is on the Air: 'Dancing Co-Ed' (Lana Turner & Artie Shaw)" 1939-09-28 Swing music craze showcase starring Lana Turner and Artie Shaw's orchestra.
